property_summary: For every call to fallback with msg.value == 10 ether and increasing timestamp, the reference contract only drains its balance when block.number % 15 == 0, so address(c).balance either stays the same or becomes zero exactly when block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant may always send a small unconditional transfer after updating pastBlockTime, so there exist inputs (block.number not divisible by 15) where address(c).balance decreases in the mutant but not in the reference.
change_summary: Insert an additional transfer to sender unconditionally after updating pastBlockTime (single-statement insertion).
